---
name: Feature / Specification Request
about: Suggest a new idea, architectural invariant, or specification enhancement for AICF
title: '[RFC] '
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''
---

**Is your proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the challenge or limitation encountered when working with AI coding agents.

**Describe the proposed solution**
A clear description of what you want to add or modify in AICF (e.g., a new artifact type, an agent rule, an adapter mechanism, a validation check).

**Target Area**
- [ ] Foundation Specification (`docs/01-foundation/`)
- [ ] Architecture Specification (`docs/02-architecture/`)
- [ ] Bootstrap & Discovery (`docs/03-bootstrap/`)
- [ ] Tool Adapters & Integrations (`docs/04-integrations/` / `adapters/`)
- [ ] Schemas (`schemas/`)
- [ ] CLI Tooling (`tooling/cli/`)
- [ ] Starter Templates (`templates/`)
- [ ] Examples (`examples/`)

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, tool references (Cursor, Claude, Gemini, Antigravity, etc.), or examples.
